summary: Corporación América Airports S.A. (NYSE: CAAP) filed a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that the Government of Argentina issued an Administrative Decision under Law 27,742 and Decree 713/2024 approving rebalancing of the concession agreement held by Aeropuertos Argentina S.A. The amendment authorizes a roughly $7.3 billion capital investment program (including VAT), with approximately $1.5 billion deployed over 2027–2031, a 15% gross-revenue concession fee, an 11-year extension for economic equilibrium plus 7 years for $600 million of direct investments, pushing expiry to February 2056, and an agreed 14.30% IRR. Passenger tariffs become U.S. dollar-denominated, with the domestic fee rising to $9.00 by January 1, 2027. Watch regulatory implementation, tariff collection mechanics, and capex funding through trusts.
